hook: An OpenAI co-inventor just raised $40M for Jev, an AI model that never hallucinates
caption:
Jev is TypeSafe AI's new "System One" model, built by a ChatGPT co-inventor who left OpenAI to fix a real problem: chatbots that hallucinate and just tell you what you want to hear.

Instead of text, Jev returns typed decisions with confidence scores, made for software to act on, not for people to read.

It just launched with a $40M seed round.
checked: TypeSafe AI / Jev launch, founder background (OpenAI, RLHF/InstructGPT/ChatGPT), $40M seed led by DCVC: https://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev
Funding details and valuation confirmation: https://en.wowtale.net/2026/09/21/235190/
